[[R5-K6/Legends|R5-K6]] was an [[R5-series astromech droid|R5-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was built by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] and belonged to [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]], the [[Red Leader/Legends|leader]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]], an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that participated in the assault on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. R5-K6 previously served at the [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Dantooine base/Legends|base]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was destroyed along with Dreis's [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] when it was shot down by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:R5-K6-TCG.jpg|thumb|left|170px|R5-K6 on Yavin 4]]
Often given a [[fanon]] designation, [[Hasbro]] made one such name canon when it identified the droid belonging to Garven Dreis as R5-K6 in a [https://www.rebelscum.com/SDCC08/Hasbro/presentation/image16.asp preview] of its 2009 releases. On February 1, 2009, Hasbro released the ''Scramble on Yavin Battle Pack'' as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The Legacy Collection]]'' action figure sets. R5-K6's action figure was a repaint of [[R5-D4/Legends|R5-D4]],<ref name="Rebelscum">{{Rebelscum|url=TLCBPScrambleonYavin.asp|text=''Star Wars: The Legacy Collection Scramble}}</ref> previously released with the collection ''Escape from Mos Eisley'' in the ''[[Star Wars: The Saga Collection]]'' in 2006.<ref name="Escape ">{{Rebelscum|url=tsc032r5d4.asp|text=''Star Wars: The Saga Collection}}</ref>

R5-K6 can be seen in his droid socket in scenes filmed from the cockpit of Garven Dreis' X-wing, as well as behind [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in the briefing room scene prior to the Battle of Yavin.<ref name="ANH" />
